card.name: Linking words before choking or failure risks
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of", "to", "with" or "suspected" that come right before a harm term like choking, choke, failure or hypersensitivity. Mostly in warnings and contraindications.

modes.label: Of before choking
modes.description: The word "of" right before choking or aspiration in warnings.
modes.example: NOT RECOMMENDED FOR CHILDREN UNDER AGE OF 4 DUE TO RISK<< OF>> CHOKING.

modes.label: Contraindication lead-ins
modes.description: Words like "suspected" or "with" inside "known or suspected" or "patients with" before a hypersensitivity or obstruction term.
modes.example: contraindicated in patients with known or<< suspected>> hypersensitivity to salicylates

modes.label: Other harm setups
modes.description: Linking words before an expected bad outcome, such as choke or kidney failure.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like "low" next, and has no clear positive push.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before a warning about choking, failure or allergy.
